[[Sociedad Deportiva Aucas|Aucas]] and [[Mushuc Runa Sporting Club|Mushuc Runa]] were relegated from the Serie A after accumulating the fewest points during the [[2016 Campeonato Ecuatoriano de Fútbol Serie A|2016 season]]. They were replaced by [[C.S.D. Macará|Macará]] and [[C.D. Clan Juvenil|Clan Juvenil]], the 2016 Serie B winner and runner-up, respectively. Macará made their 31st top-flight appearance and their first return to the Serie A since 2013, while Clan Juvenil participated in their first top-flight appearance. === Stadia and locations === {{location map+ |Ecuador |float=right |width=300 |caption=Locations of the 2017 Serie A teams. |places= {{location map~ |Ecuador |lat=-2.186101 |long=-79.924885 |label=
